warning_disclosure_notice.text: This system is for authorized use by {organization_name} only. Unauthorized access is prohibited. Activity may be monitored. Contact {support_email} or {support_phone}.

elevation_warning_text.text: You are requesting privileged elevation on {system_name}. Use is limited to approved {organization_name} duties. Misuse may result in disciplinary or legal action.

elevation_disclosure_text.text: By continuing, you acknowledge the {organization_name} elevation disclosure and agree to use elevated privileges only for authorized tasks. Report incidents to {incident_reporting_url}.

privacy_notice.text: Personal data processed by {system_name} is handled per {organization_name} privacy policy. Contact {privacy_officer_email} with privacy questions.

consent_banner_text.text: Authorized users of {system_name} consent to monitoring for security and compliance. Marking: {classification_marking}.

data_handling_notice.text: Handle {classification_marking} and other controlled information per {organization_name} policy ({department_name}). Do not redistribute outside authorized channels.

general_comments.text: Compiled program default for {organization_name} ({department_name} / CAGE {cage_code}). Update company identity under Defaults (Template variables) when leaving the demo profile.

elevation_pre_submit_ack_prompt_text.text: I have read the warning and I request elevation for an approved task.

elevation_post_grant_notice_text.text: Elevation was granted and recorded. Use the extra rights only for the approved task, then stop.

admin_session_notice.text: You are using the {organization_name} AIC Server administration console ({system_name}). Session activity may be audited. Contact {support_email}.

admin_login_notice.text: Authorized administrators only. This login is for {organization_name} ({department_name}, CAGE {cage_code}). Unauthorized access is prohibited.

privacy_notice.text: Administrator personal data is processed for access control and audit. Contact {privacy_officer_email}.

data_handling_notice.text: Admin console data may include {classification_marking}. Follow {organization_name} handling rules.
